sentences.text:
Evran Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P, And 2 Others on 7
May, 2025
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla

Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 9152 of 2025

Petitioner :- Evran Singh And 4 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P, And 2 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anita Singh,Kumari Poonam Rajpoot,Nirmla Kumari,Prem Babu Verm

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Jitendra Kumar Sinha,J.
1. Heard Ms. Anita Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners as well as Sri Rahul Asthana, learned
A.G.A. for the State respondents.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First
Information Report dated 2.4.2025, registered as Case Crime No. 113 of 2025, under Sections 498A,
323, 494 and 506 Ipc and Section 3/4 of Dp Act, Ps Kotwali Dehat,, District Etah, and for a
direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First
Evran Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P, And 2 Others on 7 May, 2025

entities.text: Evran Singh And 4 Others vs State Of U.P, And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3.  Although the prayer for quashing of FIR has been made, but without insisting on the same, only submission is that all alleged offences are punishable with imprisonment upto seven years, therefore the police authorities are bound to follow the procedure laid down under Section 35 BNSS.
The petitioners have been wrongly implicated and could not be arrested.

Reliance has been placed on the judgement of Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273 and Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 73 of 2015 with Criminal Appeal No. 1265 of 2017 Writ Petition (Criminal) No.
156 of 2017 and in Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another (2022) 10 SCC 51 and co-ordinate Division Bench of this Court in Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs. State of U.P. & 3 others in 2021 (2) ACR 1147.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: We have gone through the impugned first information report and without interfering in the same

,
we are of the opinion that the guidelines framed by the Apex Court in the above noted judgement are equally applicable to the facts of the instant case.
5. Accordingly, the instant petition also stands disposed of in terms of the judgements as noted above.
